question: In which year was the Minimum Wages Act introduced in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1948.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Minimum Wages Act was introduced in India in the year 1948.**
 
• The act was enacted to provide for** fixing minimum rates of wages in certain employments.**
 
• The act aims to prevent the exploitation of workers who are engaged in industries where wages are generally low.
 
• The act also ensures that workers get a fair wage for the work they do.
 
• The act applies to both skilled and unskilled workers and is applicable to both the organized and unorganized sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Minimum Wages Act was passed in the year 1948. **
 
• The Minimum Wages Act states that **wages should not be below a specified minimum. **
 
• 
 This law is meant to protect the interests of all workers particularly farm labourers, construction workers, factory workers, etc.
 
 
• 
 It minimized the exploitation of workers to an extent.
 
 
• 
 The main objectives of minimum wage legislation are:

 
 
• 
 To protect the employees from getting underpaid by their employers
 
 
• 
 
To prevent the exploitation of a worker by the employer
